lines.text: Kuch bhi hamesha nahi rehta. Na sukh, na dukh. Krishna ne khud bataya.
Arjun ka dil toota tha. Har taraf dard, har taraf dukh.
Yaani, he Kaunteya, sardi garmi, sukh dukh, ye sab aate hain, aur chale jaate hain.
Ye tikte nahi. Inhe sehna seekho, he Bharat.
Fail result, toota dil, bura din. Mausam ki tarah, ye bhi badlega.
Toofan mein ruko mat. Chalte raho, subah zaroor aayegi.
Jo abhi mushkil waqt se guzar raha hai, use ye bhejo. Kyunki,
